mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_transaction (channel_transaction_no, merchant_id, merchant_request_no, channel, subject, amount, currency, status, fault_scenario, checkout_token, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{channelTransactionNo}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantRequestNo}, #{channel}, #{subject}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{faultScenario}, #{checkoutToken}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (merchant_id, merchant_request_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM channel_transaction WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND channel_transaction_no=#{transactionNo} FOR UPDATE
